exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues below. Which dialogues are positive? Which are negative?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni o'qing. Qaysilari ijobiy? Qaysilari salbiy?
exercises.explanationUz:
26-betdagi 12-mashqning davomi — 3 va 4-dialoglar.

YANGI QOLIPLAR:
  IJOBIY (yumshoqroq):  Oh, yes. I like ... . They're + sifat.
  SALBIY (yumshoqroq):  No, I don't. I think they're very + sifat.

DEMAK, TO'RT DARAJA BOR:
  Yes, I LOVE ...     — juda kuchli ijobiy
  Oh, yes. I LIKE ... — oddiy ijobiy
  No, I DON'T LIKE ...— oddiy salbiy
  No, I HATE ...      — juda kuchli salbiy

YANGI SIFATLAR:
  funny — kulgili (IJOBIY ma'noda)
  noisy — shovqinli (SALBIY ma'noda)

example.speaker: 3  B
example.en: Oh, yes. I like monkeys. They're funny.
example.uz: Ha, albatta. Men maymunlarni yoqtiraman. Ular kulgili.

example.speaker: 4  B
example.en: No, I don't. I think they're very noisy.
example.uz: Yo'q, yoqtirmayman. Menimcha, ular juda shovqinli.

example.speaker: 4  Baho
example.uz: Bu dialog SALBIY — 'No, I don't' va salbiy sifat ('noisy') bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the answers to the questions, then read out the dialogue. In pairs, act out a similar dialogue about your pet.
exercises.instructionUz: Javoblarni savollarga moslang, so'ng dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing. Juftlikda o'z uy hayvoningiz haqida shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UY HAYVONI HAQIDA SO'RASHNING TO'RT SAVOLI
(Coursebook 45-betdagi 20-mashq bilan bir xil tartib):

  1) What's your ...'s name?      — ismi
  2) Is it a male or a female?    — jinsi
  3) What kind of ... is he/she?  — zoti
  4) How old is he/she?           — yoshi

DIQQAT — OLMOSH ALMASHISHI:
  2-javobdan keyin ('A male') hayvon ERKAK ekani ma'lum bo'ladi,
  shuning uchun 3 va 4-savolda 'it' emas, 'HE' ishlatiladi:
     What kind of cat is HE?
     How old is HE?

LUG'AT: a Persian = fors mushugi (uzun junli zot)

pairs.whyUz:
Ism so'raldi → ism javob berildi.
'cat's' — egalik apostrofi.

pairs.left: 2  Is it a male or a female?
pairs.whyUz:
Tanlov savoli → bittasi tanlanadi.
Shundan keyin dialogda 'he' ishlatiladi.

pairs.left: 3  What kind of cat is he?
pairs.whyUz:
Zot so'raldi → zot nomi javob berildi.
'a Persian' = fors mushugi (bosh harf bilan — mamlakat nomidan).

Yosh so'raldi → yosh javob berildi.
'four YEARS old' — 1 dan katta bo'lgani uchun ko'plik.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text about golden eagles.
exercises.explanationUz:
Matn ikki xatboshidan iborat:
  1-xatboshi — turi, qobiliyati, tanasi, og'irligi
  2-xatboshi — joyi, hayot tarzi, ovqati, umri

Bu tuzilish 16-mashqdagi yozma ish uchun namuna bo'ladi.

sentences.noteUz: 'a golden eagle' = oltin burgut (eng yirik yirtqich qushlardan).

sentences.en: They lay eggs and keep them in a nest.
sentences.uz: Ular tuxum qo'yadi va uni uyada saqlaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'lay eggs' = tuxum qo'ymoq. 'a nest' = uya.
'keep them' — 'them' = tuxumlar.

sentences.en: They can see very well and they can fly very fast.
sentences.uz: Ular juda yaxshi ko'ra oladi va juda tez ucha oladi.
sentences.noteUz: Coursebook 42-betdagi viktorinada ham: 'Eagles can't see well' — NOTO'G'RI edi.

sentences.en: They have got big wings and long tails.
sentences.uz: Ularning katta qanotlari va uzun dumlari bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'wings' va 'tails' — ko'plikda, chunki ega ham ko'plikda.

sentences.en: They have also got very strong and sharp claws to help them hunt.
sentences.uz: Yana ov qilishga yordam beradigan juda kuchli va o'tkir tirnoqlari bor.
sentences.noteUz:
'to help them hunt' — 'help somebody DO' ('to' YO'Q).
'sharp claws' — Coursebook 41-betda ham bor.

sentences.en: They weigh from three to seven kilos.
Golden eagles live in forests and mountains in many different parts of the world.
sentences.uz: Oltin burgutlar dunyoning ko'p turli qismlaridagi o'rmon va tog'larda yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: 'a mountain' = tog'. 'parts of the world' — Coursebook 40-betdagi ibora.

sentences.en: They live alone or in pairs and they eat small birds and mammals.
sentences.uz: Ular yolg'iz yoki juft-juft yashaydi va mayda qush hamda sutemizuvchilarni yeydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'alone' = yolg'iz; 'in pairs' = juft bo'lib.
Delfin va pingvin esa 'in groups' yashaydi.

sentences.en: They live for about twenty years.

exercises.instructionEn: Mark the statements as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapni matndagi aniq ma'lumot bilan solishtiring.

CHALG'ITUVCHI O'ZGARTIRISHLAR:
  birds ↔ mammals
  three–seven ↔ four–eight
  can see ↔ can't see
  twenty ↔ twelve

items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnning birinchi gapi: 'Golden eagles are BIRDS.'
Ular tuxum qo'yadi — sutemizuvchi emas.
TO'G'RI. Matnda aynan shunday: 'They are excellent hunters.'

items.sentence: 3  They weigh from four to eight kilos.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Matnda 'from THREE to SEVEN kilos' — uch-yetti, to'rt-sakkiz emas.

NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'They CAN see very well.'
Burgut juda o'tkir ko'radi — shuning uchun zo'r ovchi.

items.sentence: 5  Golden eagles live in forests and mountains.
items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Golden eagles live in forests and mountains.'

items.sentence: 6  They live for about twelve years.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda 'about TWENTY years' — yigirma, o'n ikki emas.
TALAFFUZ: twelve /twelv/, twenty /ˈtwenti/.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from Ex. 14 to fill in the chart below.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — MATNNI TARTIBGA SOLISH USULI.
Coursebook 41 va 45-betlardagi jadvallar bilan bir xil.

YETTI QATOR:
  Kind of animal — turi
  They can       — nima qila oladi
  They've got    — nimasi bor
  They weigh     — og'irligi
  They live      — qayerda yashaydi
  They eat       — nima yeydi
  They live for  — qancha yashaydi

Bu jadval 16-mashqdagi yozma ish uchun REJA bo'ladi.

items.answer: see very well, fly very fast and hunt
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They can see very well and they can fly very fast' + 'claws to help them hunt'.

items.answer: big wings, long tails and very strong and sharp claws
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'big wings and long tails' + 'very strong and sharp claws'.
Matnda: 'They weigh from three to seven kilos.'

items.answer: in forests and mountains in many different parts of the world, alone or in pairs
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'in forests and mountains in many different parts of the world' + 'alone or in pairs'.
Matnda: 'they eat small birds and mammals'.
Matnda: 'They live for about twenty years.'

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the table below and write a text about Orang-utans.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib orangutanlar haqida matn yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BERILGAN JADVAL:
  Kind of animal: mammal
  They can:       climb very well
  They've got:    long and strong arms, brown fur and very big cheeks
  They weigh:     40 - 85 kg
  They live:      in the tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra, Indonesia
  They eat:       fruit, nuts, leaves, insects and eggs
  They live for:  30 to 50 years

NAMUNA: 14-mashqdagi oltin burgut matni (ikki xatboshi).

DIQQAT — JADVALDAN MATNGA O'TISH:
  Jadvalda 'mammal' (birlik) → matnda 'Orang-utans ARE MAMMALS' (ko'plik)
  Jadvalda '40 - 85 kg' → matnda 'from 40 to 85 kilos'
  Jadvalda '30 to 50 years' → matnda 'for about 30 to 50 years'

ORANGUTAN HAQIDA:
  'orang-utan' malay tilidan: 'orang' (odam) + 'hutan' (o'rmon)
  = 'o'rmon odami'. Indoneziyaning Borneo va Sumatra orollarida yashaydi.

structure.noteUz: Jadvalda 'mammal' birlikda, matnda esa ega ko'plikda → 'mammals'.

structure.modelEn: They have babies and feed them on milk.
structure.noteUz: Har bir sutemizuvchi matnida shu gap bo'ladi (Coursebook 40, 43-betlar).
Jadvaldan: climb very well. 'can' dan keyin fe'l asos shaklida.

structure.modelEn: They have got long and strong arms, brown fur and very big cheeks.
structure.noteUz:
Jadvaldan: long and strong arms, brown fur, very big cheeks.
'a cheek' = yuz, yonoq.

structure.modelEn: Orang-utans live in the tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra, in Indonesia.
structure.noteUz:
Jadvaldan. 'tropical forests' = tropik o'rmonlar.
Borneo va Sumatra — Indoneziya orollari.

structure.modelEn: They eat fruit, nuts, leaves, insects and eggs.
They live for about 30 to 50 years.

Orang-utans are mammals. They have babies and feed them on milk. They can climb very well. They have got long and strong arms, brown fur and very big cheeks. They weigh from 40 to 85 kilos. Orang-utans live in the tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra, in Indonesia. They eat fruit, nuts, leaves, insects and eggs. They live for about 30 to 50 years.
structure.noteUz: Ikki xatboshi, 8 gap — 14-mashqdagi burgut matni tuzilishi bilan bir xil.

groups.explanationUz: Hayvon yolg'izmi yoki guruhdami — shu iboralar bilan aytiladi.

groups.ruleUz: Millat va zot nomlari (bosh harf bilan)
groups.explanationUz: Mamlakat nomidan yasalgan so'zlar DOIM bosh harf bilan.

patterns.formula: Do you like + hayvon? — Oh, yes. I like ... / No, I don't. I think they're ...
patterns.exampleEn: Do you like monkeys? — Oh, yes. I like monkeys. They're funny.
patterns.exampleUz: Maymunlarni yoqtirasizmi? — Ha, albatta. Men maymunlarni yoqtiraman. Ular kulgili.

patterns.formula: What kind of + hayvon + is he/she? — He's/She's a + zot.
patterns.exampleEn: What kind of cat is he? — He's a Persian.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanday zotdagi mushuk? — U fors mushugi.
patterns.explanationUz: Jinsi ma'lum bo'lgach 'it' o'rniga 'he' yoki 'she' ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: They lay eggs and keep them in a nest.
patterns.exampleEn: They lay eggs and keep them in a nest.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular tuxum qo'yadi va uni uyada saqlaydi.

patterns.formula: They have got ... TO HELP them + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: They have got sharp claws to help them hunt.
patterns.exampleUz: Ov qilishga yordam beradigan o'tkir tirnoqlari bor.
patterns.explanationUz: 'help somebody DO' — 'to' QO'YILMAYDI: help them HUNT.

patterns.formula: They live alone or in pairs.
patterns.exampleEn: They live alone or in pairs and they eat small birds and mammals.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular yolg'iz yoki juft yashaydi va mayda qush va sutemizuvchilarni yeydi.

patterns.formula: Jadvaldan matnga: har qator bitta gapga aylanadi.
patterns.exampleEn: Kind of animal: mammal → Orang-utans are mammals.
patterns.explanationUz: Jadvalda birlik bo'lsa ham, matnda ega KO'PLIKDA yoziladi.
